who: MIT anthropologist Christine J. Walley, PhD anthropology, New York University, 1999.

evidence.says: MIT identifies Christine J. Walley as its anthropology professor, gives her NYU doctorate (1999), and lists Rough Waters (2004).
Elena Sobrino’s June 2023 MIT dissertation Living With Crisis lists Christine Walley as advisor.
The authority names Christine J. Walley and cites Rough Waters (2004), recording both Christine Walley and Christine J. Walley as title-page forms.

notes: The shared book establishes the authority identity; the MIT repository directly confirms the listed supervision.

who: Princeton philosopher of mathematics, PhD Princeton 1960; joined its faculty in 1960.

notes: All three supervision records match. His disciplinary appointment was in philosophy, consistent with these history-of-science dissertations.
